notes: The only open-access measurement found of gas flow through as-printed FDM walls, and the basis for this project's position that the printed strut is structure, not the vacuum barrier. Caveats that ride on every number taken from it: the test articles are PLA printed through a 0.30 mm nozzle (not CF-nylon through 0.6 mm); the sealing test is a bubble/volumetric test at about 0.5 bar overpressure, sensitive to roughly mL/s flows - 9-10 orders of magnitude coarser than a vacuum leak budget in the 1e-5 mbar.L/s class, so 'completely blocked' in this paper does not mean vacuum-tight; the k = 0.98 threshold and the wall-thickness series (~0.5 mm perimeter-only walls often untenable at any k; >= 1.1 mm walls seal via a homogeneous inner layer) are from one lab, one printer, one slicer.
